result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A puts a Running status bar with a Pause booking button above the fold and keeps 'Needs you now' apart from today's requests. Each item explains in plain words what the agent did and why. B has no pause control, only the text 'agent running', and leads with a row of stat cards. It also mixes everything into one filterable list, though its expanded item explains the urgency rating well. Neither screenshot clearly shows what can or cannot be reversed for handled items. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B puts a clear Running status and a Pause booking button above the fold. Its 'Needs you now' cards explain in plain words what the agent did and why, and the spend limits and vendor heads-up give useful context. A does filter to the items that need Dede and has good detail when a row is expanded, but it has no visible pause control, shows only a small 'agent running' text, and leads with a row of count tiles. Neither screenshot clearly shows which handled actions can still be reversed and which cannot.
